The carrot plant is a member of the parsley family,  characterized by light, feathery
leaves.  Other members of this family include fennel, dill, and celery.  
The edible root of the plant is usually orange and shaped 
like a long cylindrical cone. A fibrous channel or core 
runs the length of the vegetable; usually, the smaller 
the core, the younger and sweeter the vegetable.
